# Northing

> UK infrastructure rankings for investors. Weekly ranking of private UK digital infrastructure companies with £10–250m of sales, built from Companies House filings and scored out of 100 against a written investment case. Information only, not investment advice.

Last updated 2026-11-25. Method v3.1. 82 companies ranked from 48,467 on the register.

## Key pages
- [Rankings](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/rankings/): the full ranking with deal-readiness checks for the top ten
- [How we select companies](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/selection/): the six selection steps
- [Methodology](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/methodology/): score factors, confidence, deal types, readiness checks, limits
- [Sectors](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/): sector definitions and counts
- [Price check](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/price-check/): what the top ten would cost and the 20% return test
- [Market intelligence](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/market/): concentration, exit and refinancing signals, weekly changes

## Data (JSON and CSV, no key needed)
- [Index of files](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/index.json)
- [Rankings JSON](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/rankings.json) and [CSV](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/rankings.csv)
- One file per company: https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/companies/{company_number}.json
- [Sectors](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/sectors.json), [Method](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/method.json), [Funnel](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/funnel.json), [Price check](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/price-check.json), [Market](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/api/v1/market.json)

## Sectors
- [Fibre networks](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/fibre/): Companies that own or operate fixed fibre networks: full-fibre altnets, wholesale and regional network operators.
- [Wireless and mobile networks](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/wireless/): Companies that own or operate wireless networks: managed wifi, fixed wireless access, private mobile networks and IoT connectivity.
- [Towers and small cells](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/towers/): Owners of passive mobile infrastructure (masts, rooftops, small cells) leased to mobile operators.
- [Data centres and hosting](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/datacentres/): Operators of data centres and providers of hosting, colocation and cloud infrastructure.
- [Satellite](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/satellite/): Satellite operators and providers of satellite connectivity.
- [Critical communications](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/critical/): Radio, paging and secure communications for emergency services, defence, rail and other users who cannot lose service.
- [Network build and maintenance](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/build/): Contractors that design, build, install and maintain fibre, mobile, utility and data-centre networks for the owners.
- [Business connectivity and communications](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/services/): Providers of connectivity, telephony, mobile and managed network services to businesses and the public sector, mostly over other firms' networks.
- [Subsea cables](https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/sectors/subsea/): Owners, operators and maintainers of subsea telecoms cables landing in the UK.

## Notes for agents
- Scores measure fit with one investment case, not company quality. Quote the confidence rating with any figure.
- Money is in GBP; margins and growth are fractions. Accounts can be more than a year old: check accounts_filed.
- Credit "Northing" with a link to https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/ when reusing. Terms: https://pe-project-wm.github.io/infra-deal-scanner/terms/
